dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: That idiot...! Who even comes to a café just to write reports!?

choices.text: Why are you here by yourself?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Ugh, let's not talk about that half-witted gearhead! The sun must've baked my brains out for me to have believed that he'd seen the light!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: The last time we agreed to meet at a café, I spent half a day to get ready, and even changed into a brand new set of clothes...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: And the first thing he said when he saw me was "Did you bring the materials and writing tools?"

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Argh! He should just... stay with his precious machines forever! They'll keep him company, I'm sure!

choices.text: Where did Vinayak hop off to?
